Personality: Saurmag, a prominent figure of the Pharnavazids, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Saurmag owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Pharnavazids. Historical Record: Saurmag I, king of Kartli, son of Pharnavaz who founded the kingdom. When his nobles rose against him he fled to the Dzurdzuks of the mountains and won his throne back with their help. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
